'''Wolf Squadron''' was a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|naval]] unit active during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
[[File:Mase.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Mase, Wolf Squadron's commanding officer]]

The unit was led by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Mase (Rebel)|Mase]] and conducted raids on [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] shipping along the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]], retreating with their spoils to a secret base in an asteroid field. In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], they [[Ambush on the Corellian Trade Spine|hijacked]] a [[Imperial convoy ship|cargo ship]] carrying a piece of the [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star II's]] weapons systems and brought it to [[Annamar]], their base of operations.

This action would turn out to be the unit's undoing, as [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] tasked [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] with retrieving the device. He utterly [[Battle of Annamar|decimated]] Wolf Squadron, killing all its pilots.

==Composition==
The unit consisted of at least nine [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighters]], four [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing starfighters]], one [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]] and automated [[Cannon/Legends|cannons]] hidden on various asteroids.
